दीप्तमनेकवर्णं|dīptam aneka-varṇam|dīp — to blaze, shine (dīpta: past participle 'blazing', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with tvām; joined directly before the vowel a- of anekavarṇam, no change);;aneka — many, various (first member);;varṇa — color (aneka-varṇa: 'many-colored', acc. sg. masc.; -m before the consonant v- of the next word → anusvāra ṃ)
--
व्यात्ताननं|vyātta-ānanam|vi-ā-dā — to open wide (vyātta: past participle 'gaping, wide open', first member; -a + ā- → -ā-);;ānana — mouth, face (vyātta-ānana: 'with gaping mouth', acc. sg. masc.; -m before the consonant d- → anusvāra ṃ)
दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्|dīpta-viśāla-netram|dīpta — blazing (first member);;viśāla — vast, huge, broad (second member);;netra — eye (dīpta-viśāla-netra: 'with blazing, huge eyes', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with tvām)
--
दृष्ट्वा|dṛṣṭvā|dṛś — to see (dṛṣṭvā: gerund 'having seen')
हि|hi|hi — indeed, for (particle)
त्वां|tvām|tvam — you (acc. sg.)
प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा|pravyathita-antar-ātmā|pra-vyath — to tremble (pravyathita: past participle, first member; -a + a- → -ā-);;antar — within, inner (second member);;ātman — soul, self (pravyathita-antar-ātman: 'whose inmost self is trembling', nom. sg. masc., describing the speaker, Arjuna)
--
धृतिं|dhṛtim|dhṛti — steadiness, firmness, courage, composure (acc. sg. fem.; -m before n- → anusvāra ṃ)
न|na|na — not
विन्दामि|vindāmi|vid — to find, obtain (class 6 root vid, distinct from vid 'to know'; vindāmi: present 1st sg. 'I find')
शमं|śamam|śama — peace, calm, tranquility (acc. sg. masc.; -m before c- → anusvāra ṃ)
च|ca|ca — and
विष्णो|viṣṇo|Viṣṇu — Viṣṇu, the proper name here given outright to Kṛṣṇa (vocative sg.)
